method: Original native geometry reuses unchanged owned materials. One opaque olive canvas texture generated through built-in image_gen is copied unchanged; CANVAS_PROMPT.json records the exact prompt.
limitations: Simplified static accessories, barrel/stock profiles, strings, ornaments and hidden surfaces require author review.
Shared world appearances remain independent of held quality art. Cosmetic cartridges and quiver arrows grant or consume no ammunition; gameplay and saved state remain unchanged.
